digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guards (compat, sync, push)
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching sync._union_merge must return without merging and preserve both refs unchanged
A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching push.py non-FF retry must abort immediately without merge/re-push and surface as not-completed with DIVERGED status
The epoch guard state matrix must handle all nine rows: record-absent/present and epoch-absent/present combinations, plus corrupt and unreadable remote cases
The remote .store-compat.json epoch must be read via git show and distinguished from ref-unreadable errors in log messages
write_compat_record must preserve existing valid string epochs and never generate new epoch values; non-string epochs are treated as corrupt
Merely-behind clones with matching epochs must still fast-forward converge and strictly-ahead clones must still return early, proving the guard does not wedge valid paths
